limitations: Three explicit actors: old role judgments, current-candidate evidence repair, and repaired actor plus native Responses visual-condition extraction. Initial product, goal, admitted base input and images match; declared extraction memory/input and candidate evidence questions intentionally differ.
The model supplies fallible categorical hypotheses, not verified UI semantics. An evidence reference does not establish that the hypothesis is correct.
One trial per actor/task/condition; no reproducibility, broad stability, human fidelity or causal claim. Later trajectories differ.
Charged reservations do not prove HTTP attempts or service receipt. API time and human time remain separate.
Mock results verify integration only and are never real-model performance evidence.

independentAudit.scope: 3/18 slot connectivity smoke, source, delivery, replay, selection and accounting; not full evaluation or semantic/human validation.
